#    of the education communities using this license."

# that tests "apache license" before "educational community license" also returns Apache-2.0.
# p215_says = UNCLASSIFIED is the measurement: the instrument registered to be made permanent
# cannot see this family at all. It does not mis-name it; it returns nothing.
